title: Lazy Load a Heavy Component
description: Implement lazy loading for a chart component that should only load when the user clicks a button.
problemStatement:
## Problem Statement

Create an app that displays a simple button. When the button is clicked, it should dynamically load a **HeavyChart** component that renders a large chart (simulate heavy computation with a large dataset). While the component is loading, show a "Loading..." spinner. If loading fails (simulate a 50% chance of failure), show an error message and a retry button.

Use `defineAsyncComponent` with `loadingComponent`, `errorComponent`, and `delay`/`timeout`.

The heavy component can be a simple `<div>` with a loop that generates many DOM elements to simulate weight, or use a canvas to draw many points.
hints: Create a simple async component using `defineAsyncComponent`.
For loading/error components, you can define inline template strings or separate components.
Use a `setTimeout` to simulate network delay, and optionally a random rejection to test error handling.
expectedOutput: A button that loads a heavy chart lazily with loading and error states.
